blocks.text: World music group Talahib is breathing new life into its signature song “Babaylan” after more than two decades. The band officially re-released the track to champion women’s rights and showcase indigenous Philippine sounds to a global audience. The late maestro Tony Palis originally composed “Babaylan” in 1993. It has been a staple in Talahib’s live setlists for 25 years. The group previously recorded a full-band version between 2007 and 2011. However, the members felt a studio re-release was long overdue to reach more listeners.
